responsibility: This file implements a MIPS-specific IPA optimization pass that decides when old-ABI callers can omit allocating argument frame-header space on the stack. It registers the frame-header-opt pass after comdat processing, scans GIMPLE CFGs and callgraph functions to detect leaf functions, inline assembly, and argument-passing requirements, and records results in machine_function flags such as does_not_use_frame_header, optimize_call_stack, and callers_may_not_allocate_frame for later prologue/epilogue generation decisions in the MIPS backend.
